announcements.topic: Releases and news from Ladrok. Read-only. Everything else lives at https://ladrok.com

ladrok-tv.topic: Ladrok TV: Android TV for the Raspberry Pi 5, quiet home screen, no clutter. Help, bugs, ideas. New releases post here automatically.

pins.announcements:
# Ladrok
**Bring back the simplicity of software.**
Small, quiet open source tools that work out of the box.

**Minimal config.** Sensible defaults. Little to set up.
**Minimal UI.** Only what you need, nothing that shouts.
**Yours.** Local-first, open source, no accounts.

**Built with AI.** Every Ladrok project is. If that bothers you, no hard feelings. If it doesn't, the code is open: judge the result.

**Where to go**
{#general} talk about anything Ladrok
{#ladrok-tv} Ladrok TV help, bugs and releases

Projects: <https://ladrok.com>
Code: <https://github.com/Kordal>
